[Kinetic Pinnacle](/Feats.aspx?ID=4204) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 23

</column>

---

No one can match the pace at which elements flow from you. You're permanently [quickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=32). You can use your extra action only to [Channel Elements](/Actions.aspx?ID=2124), use a 1-action [Elemental Blast](/Actions.aspx?ID=2125), or use a 1-action [stance](/Traits.aspx?ID=152) [impulse](/Traits.aspx?ID=502).
